FIELD GUIDE: THE REAL LALA

  • Two grey cat ears, both standing up
  • Purple hair ties, two on each side
  • One red mark, on HER left cheek (your right)
  • Five purple stripes on her tail
  • Three toes on each paw. A small cat mouth, no teeth
  • Blinks slowly, top to bottom
  • Eyes squint in a light. They never shine
  • Purrs when petted, meows when called
  • Her tail is attached. Tug it and she flicks it away
  • Casts a shadow. Walks forwards. Does not stare
  • Does not follow you when you look away
  • She never hums. If you hear the lullaby nearby, something is close
